definitions.explanation: Left to one's own choice or discretion; not compulsory. Commonly seen on forms, in instructions, and in legal contexts.
Chosen without specific criteria; any value or element that satisfies certain conditions. Used in technical and academic contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{任意|にんい}です。

{任意|にんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ことだ。
examples.english: Whether to enroll in optional insurance is for the individual to decide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{任意|にんい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The police conducted a voluntary interview.

examples.japanese: {任意|にんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整数|せいすう}→整数：04328_seisuu⟧n⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{成|な}り{立|た}つ→成り立つ：07921_naritatsu⟧。
examples.english: This holds for any positive integer n.

examples.japanese: {任意|にんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧P⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}び→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧、⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Choose an arbitrary point P and draw a line from it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{定理|ていり}→定理：22393_teiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{任意|にんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}できる→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: This theorem can be applied to any triangle.

notes:
USAGE:
{任意|にんい} is used as a no-adjective ({任意|にんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) or as a noun. In everyday Japanese, it most often means "optional" or "voluntary." In police and legal contexts, {任意|にんい} contrasts with ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧ (compulsory).
In police terminology, {任意|にんい} (voluntary questioning/accompaniment) contrasts with ⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧ (arrest). While technically voluntary, {任意|にんい}⟦{同行|どうこう}→同行：12028_doukou⟧ in practice is difficult to refuse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {任意|にんい}{加入|かにゅう} (voluntary enrollment)
- {任意|にんい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (optional insurance)
- {任意|にんい}⟦{同行|どうこう}→同行：12028_doukou⟧ (voluntary accompaniment to police station)
- {任意|にんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値|あたい}→値：21704_atai⟧ (any value)
